copy_policy: Named files only; owner-approved core30+allowlist, bridge22+copyset and launcher37+inventory. No recursive directory copy.
encoding_policy: All UTF-8 files are wrapped losslessly, preserving original newlines/trailing whitespace. Logs above1MiB use gzip(mtime=0), with both original and retained size/SHA256. No original bytes normalized.
historical_scope: Includes historical failures, test-fixture errors and interrupted/source-drift runs without relabeling them as current passes. Author22/core18/bridge21/launcher32 final receipts retain their original scope. Public-tag registration review and main integration evidence are separate.
scope: Lossless source/test/engineering evidence only; constructed inputs. No actual data archives, private features, target vaults, attempt directories, entropy transcripts or new scientific run.
source_checks: Each approved original hash was checked before encoding; every original and retained artifact is rechecked after round-trip decoding.
